description: Template for long RTNS steady-state experiments. Copy it and retain only physically verified cases.
notes: List serials in probe.serials when more than one camera is connected.
The physical labels are evidence annotations; topology_before.json and topology_after.json verify the setup.
Run scheduling policies in separate randomized campaign orders when collecting paper data.
Add noise as a separately controlled experiment factor, not as an unrecorded background process.
